translations.english: This mountain is spread over with various kinds of flowering trees and trees laden with fruits, shady and enchanting, mango, roseapples, asanas, lodhras, priyalas, jackfruit trees, dhavas, ankolas, lovely tinisas, bilva trees, tinduka and bamboo, kashmaya, arishta and varuna, madhukas, tilaka trees, badari and myrobalan trees, nipa trees, cane, danvas, and promegranate trees, the mountain looks splendid.
translations.hindi: तब महर्षि भरद्वाज जी ने कहा-तुम अपनी सेना को यहीं बुला लो । महर्षि की आज्ञा पा कर, भरत जी ने अपनी सेना वहीं बुलवा लो
